title: Use GPT, Claude, and Gemini on your Mac for life for $69.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Replace your separate AI writing, image, and audio apps with a 1min.AI lifetime subscription for $69.97 (reg. $540).

Writing, image editing, and voiceovers each tend to need their own AI app with their own monthly bill. Mac users who make content often pay for three or four of them at once. You can avoid that with 1min.AI, an all-in-one AI app for macOS, and its Advanced Business Plan lifetime subscription drops to $69.97 (reg. $540).

For images, you can generate new pictures, upscale old ones, remove backgrounds or stray objects, and turn a rough sketch into a finished image. Writing help includes a rewriter, expander, shortener, and summarizer. In the chat window, you choose between GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude 4.6 Sonnet, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and other models. Audio and video tools are in the same app, with text-to-speech, voice cloning, a caption generator, and YouTube summaries.

Every month, you’ll get 4 million credits, enough for about 1,186 images or 1.1 million words. Visiting the web app each day adds 15,000 bonus credits, up to 450,000 a month on top of that. Up to 20 people can share one account, and 1min.AI also runs on iPhone and iPad for edits away from your desk. AI drafts still need a human edit, so plan to review what it makes before you publish it.

Write, design, and record with AI from one Mac app.

Get a 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan lifetime subscription on sale for $69.97.

Offer ends November 8.
